title: Kidde Recalls to Replace Fire Extinguishers Due to Failure to Operate
summary: The pressurized cylinders in the recalled fire extinguishers could lose pressure and fail to operate. In the event of a fire, this failure could put a consumer and property at risk. Units: About 167,000.

title: Pure Fishing Recalls Children's Fishing Games Due to Violation of Ban on Lead in Paint
summary: The label on the fishing rod contains a surface coating containing high levels of lead in violation of the ban on lead in paint. Units: About 2,600.

title: Seattle Cotton Works Hooded Sweatshirts with Drawstrings Recalled Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The sweatshirts have a drawstring through the hood that can pose a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 40,000.

title: Tippmann A-5 Paintball Markers Recalled for Repair Due to Risk of Injury
summary: The end cap assembly on the rear of certain A-5® markers can break and eject during use, posing a risk of injury to the operator. Units: About 13,000.

title: Valero Marketing & Supply Co. Announce Recall to Inspect Propane Gas; Can Pose Fire and Burn Hazard
summary: An odorant is added to propane to help alert customers to a propane gas leak, but this propane might not have the recommended level of odorant. Failure to detect leaking gas can present a fire, explosion or thermal burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 919,000 barrels.

title: Electra Bicycle Company Recalls Bicycles with Front Trays; Trays Can Come Loose and Pose Fall Hazard to Riders
summary: The front tray on the bicycle can come loose and contact the front tire, posing a fall hazard to riders. Units: About 3,000.

title: Hair Dryers Recalled By Big Lots Stores, Inc. Due to Electrocution Hazard
summary: The hair dryers are not equipped with an immersion protection device to prevent electrocution if the hair dryer falls into water. Electric shock protection devices are required by industry standards for all electric hand-held hair dryers. Units: About 31,000.

title: Ice Skates Recalled by Pronto Sports Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Surface paint on the ice skates contains excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 600 pairs.

title: Infantino Recalls Infant Toys Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The infant toys have blue metallic fabric that can detach from the toy, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 172,000 in the United States, and 12,000 in Canada.

title: Maytag Recalls Refrigerators Due to Fire Hazard
summary: An electrical failure in the relay, the component that turns on the refrigerator's compressor, can cause overheating and pose a serious fire hazard. Units: About 1.6 million.

title: Off-Road Bike Engine Parts Recalled by Wiseco Due to Crash Hazard
summary: Engine stress could cause the connecting rods to crack and the engine to lock up, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 420.

title: Wall-Mounted Radiators Recalled by Rettig Belgium Due to Crush Hazard; Child's Death Reported
summary: The radiator can come loose from the wall, and fall on people near it. Units: About 36 in the United States, 113,000 worldwide.

title: All-Clad Recalls 4-Square Belgian Waffle Makers Due to Shock Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Williams-Sonoma
summary: Wiring inside the waffle maker can be damaged and contact the waffle maker's metal body, posing a shock or fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 30,000.

title: Holiday Lights Recalled by Universal Distribution Center Due to Shock and Fire Hazard
summary: The lights have undersized wires that can easily pull out of the plugs and light sockets becoming exposed. This poses an electric shock and fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 52,000.

title: Ritchie Immersion Heaters Recalled By Springfield Wire Due to Shock Hazard
summary: The outer cover of the immersion heater can crack and expose the heating element to water, posing a shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 13,000.

title: Children's Flip Flops Recalled by Alpargatas Due to Violation of Lead in Paint Standard
summary: Decorative paint on the sole of the flip flops can contain levels of lead in excess of the federal standard. Units: About 210,000.

title: Frontrow Recalls to Replace Rechargeable Batteries Sold with PA System Microphones Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The batteries can rapidly overheat, posing a burn hazard to the user. Units: About 41,000.

title: Nautilus Recalls Bowflex Home Gyms Due to Risk of Injury
summary: The home gym's horizontal seat rail is designed to be latched in a vertical position for storage. If the seat rail is not manually latched, it can fall unexpectedly on the user or a bystander, posing a risk of serious injury. Units: About 78,000 (This recall was first announced in Dec. 2007).

title: Seventh Avenue Recalls Tealight Candleholders Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The faceted resin accents on the sides of the candleholder can ignite, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 430.

title: Central Fireplace Recalls Fireplaces Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: Excess gas can accumulate in the firebox if the pilot light is not lit or has gone out. When consumers relight the pilot light, the accumulated gas can ignite with force and shatter the glass fireplace doors posing a serious laceration hazard. Units: About 760.

title: Cordless Stick Vacuums Recalled by Electrolux Home Care Products Due to Bursting Batteries
summary: The vacuum's battery can expand and burst, posing a risk of injury to the user and bystanders. Units: About 320,000.

title: Lenovo Recalls ThinkVision Speaker AC Adaptors Due to Shock Hazard
summary: The plastic shell of the AC Adaptor can crack, posing a risk of electric shock to consumers. Units: About 230.

title: Outerwears Inc. Recalls Filters Used in Fuel Funnels Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The Funnel Pre-Filters can create a flash when they are removed from the fuel tank posing a fire hazard. Units: About 500.

title: Children's Fishing Poles Recalled by Zebco Due to Violation of Lead in Paint Standard
summary: The paint on the reels of these fishing poles contains excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 2,700.

title: Children's Hooded Fleece Jackets with Drawstrings Recalled by Golden Grove Trading Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The jackets have a drawstring through the hood, which can pose a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 6,100.

title: Children's Hooded Sweatshirts Recalled by MM Compound Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The sweatshirts have a drawstring through the hood, which can pose a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 2,200.

title: Children's Hooded Sweatshirts with Drawstrings Recalled by Dysfunctional Clothing Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The jackets have a drawstring through the hood, which can pose a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 450.

title: Children's Hooded Sweatshirts with Drawstrings Recalled by Rusty North America Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The sweatshirts have a drawstring through the hood, which can pose a strangulation hazard to children. Units: 635.

title: Holiday Lights Recalled by Four Star Group USA Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Safeway Stores
summary: Electrical wiring in the lights can overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 13,000.

title: La Jolla Sport Recalls Children's Hooded Sweatshirts with Drawstrings Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The jackets have a drawstring through the hood, which poses a strangulation hazard. Units: About 9,700.

title: Aviva Sports Recalls Trampolines Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The metal support legs of the trampoline can bend or break and the bungee cords that secure the mat to the frame of the trampoline can fray or break, posing a fall hazard to the user. Units: About 14,000.

title: Fisher-Price Recalls 3-in-1 High Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The seat can fall backwards from high chair frame if the booster seat release is unlatched while the child is in the product. Also, the seat back can detach if not fully snapped in place, posing a fall hazard and risk of serious injury to young children. Units: NumberOfUnit 24,000.

title: Pacifiers Recalled by OKK Trading Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The pacifiers are banned under federal law. They failed federal safety tests when the nipples separated from the base. This poses a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 2,900.

title: Desktop Computers Recalled By Acer America Corp. Due to Overheating, Burn Hazard
summary: The insulation on the computer's internal wiring can become bent or stripped, causing the wires to overheat while the product is in use. This poses a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 215.

title: Educational Craft Kits Recalled by FloraCraft Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The surface coating on the educational kit's wires can contain excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 930,000.

title: Gas Generators Recalled by Sycamore SCS Due to Fire Hazard
summary: A plastic sediment cup attached to the bottom of the fuel valve can crack during shipping and handling and cause fuel leakage or spillage, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,500.

title: Human Touch Recalls Perfect Chair to Fix Screw Drive Due to Entanglement Hazard
summary: The screw on the underside of the Perfect Chair recliner can cut or entangle children or pets. Units: About 20,000.

title: Montessori N' Such Recalls Metal Vases, Pails and Other Containers Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Surface paints on the products contain excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 1,000.

title: Cannondale Recalls Road Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The bicycles fail to meet the federal safety standard for bicycles. Spoke protector discs, required on bicycles to prevent the bicycle chain from interfering or suddenly stopping the wheel, are missing from these bicycles. This poses a fall hazard to the rider. Units: About 1,300.

title: Kubota Recalls Riding Mowers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The carburetor can fail allowing fuel to leak, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 9,500.

title: Nordstrom Recalls Girl's Shoes Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Surface paint on the outer sole of these shoes contains excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 31,000.

title: State Farm® Recalls Good Neigh Bears® Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The eyes on these bears can come off, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 800,000 in the United States and 27,000 in Canada.

title: Clothing Irons Recalled by Conair Corporation Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The clothing iron can overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 45,000.

title: Yamaha Motor Corp. Offers Free Repair For 450, 660, and 700 Model Rhino Vehicles CPSC advises consumers not to use the off-road vehicles until repaired
summary: The lack of a spacer on the rear wheels and the presence of the rear anti-sway bar impair vehicle handling and pose a risk of rollover. Units: About 120,000 Rhino 450s and 660s and 25,000 Rhino 700s.
